brief.headline: Close the 13.6% price gap to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG and recover ₹14.26 L annual excess — we have three credible alternates ready to quote.

priceAsk.summary: Reduce Dextrose Anhydrous IP from ₹75.51/KG to ₹66.48/KG to match our best price
priceAsk.target: ₹66.48/KG — the rate Sayaji Industries Limited gives us today
priceAsk.basis: Current 13.6% gap costs us ₹14.26 L/yr excess; India export unit value sits at 42.95 ₹/kg, so our ask is reasonable and still above market line

paymentTermAsk.summary: No change needed — 30 Days After Receipt is acceptable

brief.financialLeverage: Universal Starch earned ₹514.62 Cr revenue with 3.7% net margin and 7.4% EBITDAMARGIN, 0.73x debt-to-equity, and 17.6% return on capital — financials are stable but margins are thin. Their C health score (58/100) signals moderate resilience. We represent only 0.12% of their revenue (₹59.65 L spend), so our standalone leverage is minimal. However, they are growing at 21.4%/yr and value incremental volume. We can trade a volume commitment for the price cut, but must keep Gulshan, Sanstar, and Tirupati warm as alternates to create competitive tension.

evidence.point: We pay 13.6% more than our cheapest supplier for the same Dextrose
Annual excess cost versus best price we already secure elsewhere
Sayaji Industries delivers Dextrose Anhydrous IP at this lower rate today
India export benchmark shows dextrose trades well below our current price
Universal Starch's thin net margin leaves limited room but is not distressed
They are growing fast and will want to protect volume share

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, B health score (62/100) — established dextrose supplier and a drop-in alternate

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹821.13 Cr revenue, C health (53/100) — growing dextrose capacity

alternates.name: Tirupati Starch & Chemicals Ltd
alternates.why: Listed Indore wet-miller, ₹365.39 Cr revenue, makes Dextrose ANHYDROUS IV-fluid grade — exact form match with IP monograph available

risks: At 0.12% of their ₹514.62 Cr revenue, we lack solo leverage — they may walk if we push without a volume sweetener or visible competitive threat
Thin 3.7% net margin means a steep cut could squeeze them harder than peers; anchor the ask on our existing ₹66.48/KG price, not the 42.95 ₹/kg export floor
Tirupati's D health score (27/100) and Roquette India's D (28/100) mean two alternates carry higher risk — prioritize Gulshan (B, 62/100) if we need to switch fast
No borrowing-cost data available, so early-payment discount is off the table as a lever
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but at ₹75.51/KG we're paying 13.6% over the ₹66.48/KG that Sayaji gives us for identical Dextrose — let's close that gap and talk about a volume commitment in return.
